rules.rule: Orchestrator: Fable plans, splits, reviews, merges. Code by Sonnet subagents only (.claude/agents/coder.md), one folder each per docs/OWNERS.md, parallel only on separate folders. No Muse Wonder, no other coding agents; the Muse Spark key is a reserve only.
Never invent data: every number on screen has a PSI row or a curated NASA source link.
Merge one PR at a time, rebased on main, with scripts/check.ps1 green.
Stuck: 3 failures on the same thing → write it in STATE.md, take the next task.
After every action update ACTIONS.md (last action, table, log).
The repo stays private. No deploy to a public host until Karim chooses one.
Do not edit docs/design/, docs/STORY.md, docs/wireframes/ (design session).
